structured_output.content: The change adds an optional Vault issuer setting for the server name used when validating the Vault server's certificate. The environment summary shows only certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] installed and only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests. No Issuer or ClusterIssuer CRD or manifest is listed, so no Vault issuer appears to exist. The change is a new opt-in feature, and the excerpt states no behavior change for existing configurations.
